item.title: Autocar and Bubble Car to feature at Weardale Railway event
item.description: On Sunday, 15 March 2026, Weardale Railway will see its historic NER autocar running alongside British Rail Class 122 ‘Bubble Car’ for the first time in its history.

item.title: Yorkshire station clocktower refurb begins
item.description: Work to restore Scarborough station has been underway since April 2025 and has been progressing well.

item.title: Glow-in-the-dark mural unveiled at Sussex railway station
item.description: Rail operator Southern partnered with Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, street artist SinnaOne and the Brighton Toy and Model Museum to deliver a large-scale artwork. The glow-in-the-dark mural has been unveiled at the top of Trafalgar Street, beneath Brighton railway station, designed to draw foot traffic towards the area’s independent shops and eateries.

item.title: ScotRail to introduce new fare to tackle fare evaders
item.description: Each year, fare evasion costs Scotland's Railway over £11 million, and ScotRail is bringing in a new minimum fare to reduce this.

item.title: Essex railway to welcome electric steam locomotive in UK first

item.title: Ride on steam locomotive 60103 Flying Scotsman in Hampshire
item.description: This March, Flying Scotsman will be steaming into Hampshire for a spectacular stay at the Watercress Line, giving visitors a rare chance to get up close to the world's most famous locomotive.

item.title: How to help City of Peterborough steam locomotive return to steam
item.description: Nene Valley Railway have launched an appeal to help restore Standard Class 5 No. 73050, ‘City of Peterborough’.

item.title: Emily unveiled for Dovetail Games’ Thomas and Friends game
item.description: Episode 3 of Thomas and Friends highlights one of Sodor’s most compassionate and capable engines, Emily.

item.title: Step into Wonderland this Easter at the Churnet Valley Railway
item.description: This Easter, the Churnet Valley Railway in the Staffordshire Moorlands is inviting families to step into the whimsical world of Alice in Wonderland. From the team behind the Polar Express Train Ride, the Alice in Wonderland Tea Party promises a magical experience for all ages.

item.title: Manchester City and James Arthur fans reminded of railway station closure
item.description: Transport for Greater Manchester (TfGM) is encouraging passengers to plan journeys in advance and allow plenty of time for travel during a nine-day closure of Piccadilly Station and a weekend of events in the city.
